title: Loved by Streamers Worldwide
subtitle: See what creators are saying about PNGTuberMaker.

items.name: kira_ttv
items.content: Pasted the OBS link, and my avatar just started moving with my mic. Took maybe 2 minutes total. My chat noticed before I even said anything lol.

items.name: jakedraws
items.content: I literally cannot draw a stick figure. Typed a description, picked from 4 options, generated the expressions — done. The fact that they all look consistent is what sold me.

items.name: noa_plays
items.content: Was using a Live2D model that kept crashing OBS. This is just a browser source — way lighter, no plugins, and honestly looks better on stream than what I had before.
